rows: Marble to golfball size hail fell northwest of Mentone.
A tornado formed over open country north of Mentone. No damage occurred.
A storm moved over Loving County and produced three to four inch hail six miles east of Orla. Wind gusts were up to 70 to 75 mph.
A thunderstorm moved over Loving County and produced four inch hail and wind gusts of 70 to 80 mph two miles west of Mentone.

A thunderstorm in Reeves County produced a tornado about eight miles west of Mentone. A National Weather Service survey team was unable to locate damage directly caused by the tornado due to poor road networks. Photos provided by the public and emergency management suggested that…

A thunderstorm moved across Loving County and produced wind damage. There were 30 power poles that were broken and blown down seven miles north of Mentone. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A trained spotter observed quarter to half dollar size hail in Mentone.
Hail was observed at the Tornado Gas Plant.
Lots of hail on the ground, and some may be larger. Picture from public Facebook photo.
Quarter-sized hail reported on State Highway 302 per spotter network. Time is estimated from radar.
Quarter-size hail was reported by the public in rural Loving County. The time of occurrence is estimated from radar.
